payload.title: Custom app routes (server-authoritative command endpoints) in the Rust server
payload.description:
The TS @fricken/server accepted `appRoutes` — app-defined authenticated HTTP handlers mounted alongside the framework routes, with access to the live store. Zavro uses this for server-authoritative command endpoints (createCommandRoutes() + bindStore(liveStore)). The Rust server has fixed framework routes + per-app base_path nesting but NO injection point for app-supplied route handlers.

Scope: a mechanism for an embedder (and ultimately the language-agnostic extension model, see sibling ticket) to register additional authenticated routes that can read/write the store and reuse the auth/principal extraction. Blocks downstream apps (Zavro) that expose server-authoritative commands beyond the schema-driven data plane.
